WITH team_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        team_id,
        AVG(CAST(w AS REAL)) as avg_wins,
        AVG(
            CASE 
                WHEN l IS NOT NULL AND l != 0 
                THEN (CAST(g AS REAL) - CAST(l AS REAL)) / CAST(l AS REAL) 
                ELSE NULL 
            END
        ) as avg_ratio
    FROM manager_half
    WHERE team_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY team_id
),
overall_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(avg_wins) as overall_avg_wins
    FROM team_stats
    WHERE avg_wins IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    ts.team_id,
    ts.avg_wins,
    ts.avg_ratio,
    ts.avg_wins - oa.overall_avg_wins as wins_diff
FROM team_stats ts
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
WHERE ts.avg_wins IS NOT NULL
  AND oa.overall_avg_wins IS NOT NULL
  AND ts.avg_wins > oa.overall_avg_wins
ORDER BY 
    CASE WHEN wins_diff IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
    wins_diff DESC
LIMIT 10
